step_by_step_reasoning: The visual architecture shows edge nodes on the left communicating with Amazon EKS and Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. EKS integrates with MongoDB and Amazon DynamoDB. Kinesis Data Streams feeds into Kinesis Data Firehose, which outputs to Amazon S3. S3 is queried by Snowflake for analytics.
